instruction: A candid outdoor photograph captures a sunny beach scene with a volleyball net. In a full shot, the man in the light blue t-shirt (R3) on the left and the woman in the black bikini (R2) on the right walk forward on the sand. The man (R3) holds a volleyball under his arm and smiles down at the woman (R2) as they fist-bump with their inner hands. The woman (R2), carrying an orange tote bag and a white bottle, smiles warmly. Bright, warm daylight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the sand.
